raw.rationale: This is a multi-kinase EGFR/ERBB2/ERBB4/AKT1 inhibitor, so selective killing is most plausible in EGFR- or ERBB2-addicted lineages such as lung (EGFR-mutant/amplified), breast (HER2+/ERBB2-amplified), and upper aerodigestive/gastric/esophageal tumors with ERBB family dependence; most other lineages should be near baseline. Published PRISM-type screens show EGFR inhibitors are rarely lineage-selective beyond these ERBB-driven subsets, so probabilities are kept low and concentrated in lung, breast, and upper aerodigestive/gastric/esophageal lineages.
